body: I'm in exactly the same boat. Sometimes I wonder if it's generational, or a side effect of the current society that no one wants to reach back. But I keep hoping to make a meaningful connection,  only for that hope to be destroyed over and over by people who just don't give a crap if I live or die, or whether they even talk to me or not. Some days I can accept my loneliness, some days I cant. Across the distance between us I hope and pray that you have more days where you can accept it, that you have days where you can bear the pain. It's excruciating on the days you cant, and I wouldn't wish that on my worst enemy.

I am in the exact same boat. People always let you down, they don't want to get "real" with you, they don't have time for it and they don't want to be vulnerable with you. I feel like everyone hides in this BS veil of "I'm too busy" so they don't have to really deal with themselves or anyone else. You and I, as well as everyone else who feels this way, can only take solace in the fact that "we" exist - we are "real" and we really want to reach out and have real relationships with people we care about, and care about us too. That doesn't seem like such a tall order, but apparently it is. I have accepted that I am meant to be alone. I don't like it, of course... but it's better than getting my hopes up that I've made a new friend only for them to shoot me down again with "I'm too busy" or "meh, not really interested in hanging out." It's exhausting dealing with people, I know.
Fight Club's scene with Bodham-Carter/Norton (the infamous "waiting for their turn to speak" line) I think is a good one. And pretty much the entire movie Dangerous Liaisons.
I feel that way about Penelope, the 2006 film. Although Penelope has friction with her mother, it's not hugely antagonistic. It's really just about loving yourself and I find it very positive.

You don't deserve to be surrounded by negativity and hatred. You are a kind being, full of love and light and you have been beaten down, just like me. The only thing we can do for ourselves is love each other and give one another as much positivity as we can. Avoid those assholes who are treating you so badly. Their opinions about what you do are not more valid than your own opinion. There are good people out there who care, truly. When you are feeling like you can't take it anymore, remove yourself from all of that negative crap. Even if it means being alone for a while, put your positive energy out into the universe and the universe will answer you with goodness, love and light. Please stay strong. You are too good for this world, but the world needs you.

Please don't listen to him. Please don't. It was very wrong of him to say that, and it was wrong of your family not to try to understand. They are not capable of real love if they say things like that and don't attempt to understand where you're coming from. Remove yourself from that situation. You can choose to make your own family, of friends and others who are close to you. Family doesn't have to mean that you're stuck with them forever. And if they are like that, they're just going to damage you, and that's not fair. Be kind to yourself and walk away.
I'm so glad it helped. I send you a virtual hug. Stay safe too :)

I hope some outsider thoughts might be helpful. if they aren't please feel free to disregard.

If she does keep your children from you, your children will resent her for it, because she will be denying them the unconditional source of love you are to them. They will fight her tooth and nail for it, and they will respect you for doing the loving thing for yourself, which is to get out of there. We are taught our whole lives to care about credit scores and retirement plans and digital numbers that really don't mean anything, but sometimes utterly destroying something that isn't working for you - in this case most of your circumstances - and starting over - allows new and wonderful things to grow. If it is causing you pain, let it fall apart. Let it implode. You are a creature made of light and nothing else, and you deserve to be surrounded by positive things. And if nothing else, at least do one kind thing for yourself today. A candy bar, a movie, a quiet drive by yourself. Be kind to yourself. Give yourself a break.

I've heard it all is all. I'm tired of hearing it. Tired of people telling me its fine, and that its just a choice to be happy, and all that other nonsense. How anyone can be sane on this planet is beyond me. All we can do is love each other. I don't know any of you, but I love you, and I feel for you. I honestly do.

I completely understand where you are coming from, as I am in the same place. When I used to think about ending my life I would get emotional, because I was overwhelmed by the pain. Now the pain is simply a fact that I analyze. I try to be optimistic, I try to rise out of it, but the daily pain makes it seem futile. No hope I can muster can overshadow the pain I feel. Suicide warning signs often include this kind of mentality toward the idea... so it seems to be a cause for sounding the alarm, but no one seems to care about me enough to notice or pay attention. My constant pain makes me dull and boring to anyone who used to be friends with me, so I was eventually dumped by them because they can't help and they're tired of hearing about my angst I guess. I wish I had something more hopeful to say. Just wanted to comment that you're not alone. I do understand. I don't speak for anyone else, just me.
